record.one_liner: Hosted website builder and ecommerce platform whose Commerce APIs expose store data (products, orders, inventory, profiles/contacts, transactions, discounts, webhooks).
record.auth_notes: Both sent as Authorization: Bearer. Merchant-generated API key (Settings > Advanced > Developer API Keys, shown once, never expires while site is active) for custom single-site apps; OAuth client (account.squarespace.com/developer-apps) for multi-site/commercial apps. Webhook Subscriptions API is OAuth-only. User-Agent header required.
record.access_notes: API keys require a site on the Commerce Advanced plan (per vendor auth page). OAuth client registration requires Squarespace review and approval; approval allows OAuth connections but is separate from Extensions listing. OAuth plan requirement for developers not stated.
record.blocker: API-key access needs the Commerce Advanced plan on the user's site; OAuth (needed for webhooks and multi-tenant toolkit) needs Squarespace approval. Rate-limit numbers not verified. API covers commerce data, not page/content editing.
